description: This file contains test functions for the 'repositories' package, specifically testing the 'CommitRepository' functionalities such as inserting commit rows, retrieving the most recent commits, and fetching first-seen timestamps within a database context.

methods.name: getCommitRowCount
methods.description: Helper function to get the current count of rows in the 'project_commit' table.

methods.name: TestInsertCommitRows
methods.description: Unit test for inserting commit rows into the database and verifying the row count.

methods.name: TestCommitGetMostRecentOuterKey
methods.description: Test for retrieving the most recent outer key (timestamp and UUID) from the repository.

methods.name: TestGetMostRecentCommits
methods.description: Test for fetching the most recent commit records.

methods.name: TestGetMostRecentCommitsEmpty
methods.description: Test for fetching recent commits when the database is empty.

methods.name: TestGetFirstSeenTimestamp
methods.description: Test for retrieving the first seen timestamp of specific commits.

methods.name: TestGetFirstSeenTimestampEmpty
methods.description: Test for fetching first seen timestamps with no commits present.

methods.name: TestGetFirstSeenTimestampMutateReturned
methods.description: Test to ensure returned map from getFirstSeenTimestamp can be mutated without issues.

methods.name: TestGetFirstSeenTimestampNonExistent
methods.description: Test for fetching timestamps for non-existent commit hashes, ensuring defaults are correctly handled.
